title: 第0021章 炼气四层白羽彤的惊讶第0022章 进入外门优厚待遇
slug: 五灵根修炼慢我有百倍灵药空间
content_zh:
;;
第一个玉简是寒潭开采寒冰铁矿，这是一种炼器峰用来炼器的珍贵铁矿。
一件法器加入寒冰铁矿，使用起来能够带着摄人的寒冰之力，威力大幅度增强。
但是有很大的几率会寒气入体，轻则筋脉受损，重则修为倒退再无精进的可能。
第二个玉简是试药童子，给一些研究丹方的丹师实验丹药的效果，报酬很是丰厚，不仅有功德，每个月还有一枚灵石领取。
回报越高风险越大，这个任务有着极大的死亡风险。
还有照看灵兽任务，遇到性格温和的灵兽还好，遇到性格暴躁的灵兽有可能受伤，
也有简单的，比如帮助炼符师炼制符纸，要求掌握基础的炼符技能。
帮忙外门弟子照顾灵田，需要修为炼气三层，还有掌握熟练的云雨术。
陆青禾看了一圈，几乎没有他能够接的任务。
看陆青禾为难，白羽彤开口：“师弟如若找不到合适的任务，我这里倒是有一个。”
陆青禾看向白羽彤：“请师姐明示。”
白羽彤说道：“在赵国境内疑似妖魔出现，正好在我们太玄宗地界，宗门打算派出两名外门弟子和十名杂役弟子去查探。
这个时间半个月时间，只要返回，可获得五块灵石的奖励。”
说完白羽彤含笑的看着陆青禾，五块灵石的奖励，这任何一个外门弟子都拒绝不了的酬劳。
只是这次让白羽彤意外了。
陆青禾直接拒绝：“多谢师姐好意，可是师弟自知实力低微，接不了此等任务。”
陆青禾知道妖魔，一些是修炼有成的妖兽精怪，一些是修炼魔功的魔道修士。
但是无论是妖兽精怪还是魔道修士都不好惹，他可不想将自己置身危险之中。
还有五块灵石，他根本不放在眼中，他黑土空中现在还堆着71块。

他需要灵石只要想办法将黑土空间中全部的灵米和血参卖掉，都可以获得数千灵石。
陆青禾拿出一枚玉简：“师姐，我打算接下这个寻找灵药的任务。”
寻找十株灵药，这也是杂役弟子几乎不能够完成的任务，但是相对自由度高。
最关键是对陆青禾来说不难，他只需要找到灵药种子，就可以获得灵药，黑土空间中的十年份的灵药就满足这个要求。
白羽彤惊讶的看着陆青禾，陆青禾竟然拒绝了，还接了一个更加困难的任务。
白羽彤也没有说什么，对着陆青禾说道：“那这个任务就交给师弟了，师弟只需要在年底拿出十株灵药交来事务殿就可以了。”
“多谢师姐！”
陆青禾将玉简放进腰间的储物袋，匆忙的离开事务殿。
陆青禾离开，白羽彤低声自语：“看来这杂役院也是有着一些人才的。”
虽然陆青禾让她心生好奇，只不过一个杂役弟子，也没有太放在心上，继续开始整理自己的事情。
陆青禾没有回到自己的住处，而是径直的来到杂役交易区。
他拿出牌子写下几个字：高价收购灵药种子，另收购木系术法，金系术法和小云雨术。
这次陆青禾倒没有掩藏自己的身份，在宗门之中，他不可能一直掩饰自己的身份。
这倒是引起不少的修士关注，但是相比起之前直接拿出灵米售卖，关注度很低。
陆青禾等了一个下午，都没人找他交易。
陆青禾起身离开了，他明白在这个地方想要找到他需要的东西几乎是不可能的事情。

The first jade slip is Hantan's mining of ice iron ore, which is a precious iron ore used to refine weapons in the Weapon Refining Peak.
When a magic weapon is added with ice iron ore, it can bring the power of intoxicating ice when used, and its power is greatly enhanced.
However, there is a high chance that cold air will enter the body, which may damage the muscles and meridians in a mild case, or lead to a regression in cultivation and no possibility of advancement.
The second jade slip is a medicine test boy who tests the effects of elixirs for some alchemists who study elixir recipes. The reward is very generous. Not only does he have merit, but he also receives a spiritual stone every month.
The higher the reward, the greater the risk, and this mission carries a huge risk of death.
There is also the task of taking care of spirit beasts. It’s okay to meet a spirit beast with a gentle personality, but you may be injured if you encounter a spirit beast with a violent personality.
There are also simple ones, such as helping a talisman refiner to refine talisman paper, which requires mastering basic talisman refining skills.
To help the outer disciples take care of the spiritual field, one needs to cultivate to the third level of Qi Refining and master the skill of Cloud and Rain.
Lu Qinghe looked around and found that there were almost no tasks that he could take on.
Seeing Lu Qinghe's dilemma, Bai Yutong said: "If junior brother can't find a suitable task, I have one here."
Lu Qinghe looked at Bai Yutong: "Senior sister, please clarify."
Bai Yutong said: "A suspected demon appears in the territory of Zhao State, which happens to be in the territory of our Taixuan Sect. The sect plans to send two outer disciples and ten servant disciples to investigate.
If you return within half a month of this time, you will be rewarded with five spiritual stones. "
After speaking, Bai Yutong looked at Lu Qinghe with a smile. The reward of five spiritual stones was a reward that no outer disciple could refuse.
But this time, Bai Yutong was surprised.
Lu Qinghe refused directly: "Thank you, senior sister, for your kindness, but junior brother knows that his strength is low and he cannot take on such a task."
Lu Qinghe knew about demons. Some were monsters and spirits who had successfully practiced magic, and some were demonic monks who practiced demonic arts.
But neither monsters nor demonic monks were easy to mess with, and he didn't want to put himself in danger.
There are still five spiritual stones, but he doesn't pay attention to them at all. There are still 71 stacked in the black sky.
If he needs spiritual stones, he can get thousands of spiritual stones as long as he finds a way to sell all the spiritual rice and blood ginseng in the black earth space.
Lu Qinghe took out a jade slip and said, "Senior sister, I plan to take over the task of finding the elixir."
Finding ten elixirs is a task that is almost impossible for handyman disciples, but it has a relatively high degree of freedom.
The most important thing is that it is not difficult for Lu Qinghe. He only needs to find the elixir seeds to obtain the elixir. The ten years of elixirs in the black earth space meet this requirement.
Bai Yutong looked at Lu Qinghe in surprise. Lu Qinghe actually refused and accepted a more difficult task.
Bai Yutong didn't say anything, and said to Lu Qinghe: "Then this task will be handed over to the junior brother. The junior brother only needs to bring out ten elixirs and hand them over to the Affairs Hall at the end of the year."
"Thank you, senior sister!"
Lu Qinghe put the jade slips into the storage bag on his waist and left the affairs hall in a hurry.
After Lu Qinghe left, Bai Yutong whispered to himself: "It seems that there are some talents in this courtyard."
Although Lu Qinghe made her curious, she was just a handyman disciple, so she didn't take it too seriously and continued to sort out her own affairs.
Lu Qinghe did not return to his residence, but went straight to the handyman trading area.
He took out a sign and wrote a few words: Purchase elixir seeds at a high price, and also purchase wood spells, gold spells and small cloud and rain spells.
Lu Qinghe did not hide his identity this time. In the sect, he could not always hide his identity.
This attracted a lot of attention from the monks, but compared to selling the spiritual rice directly before, the attention was very low.
Lu Qinghe waited all afternoon, but no one approached him to trade.
Lu Qinghe stood up and left, knowing that it was almost impossible to find what he needed in this place.
